## Selected work

- Docs Drive — https://docsdrive.dgwebdex.com — AI-powered document intelligence for invoices and warranties (OCR, Amazon Bedrock, vector search, WebSockets).
- Block Maps — https://block-maps.vercel.app/map — QR-based routing for exact house numbers in a residential block.
- LibCompare — https://libcompare.vercel.app/ — Compare React UI / styling libraries.

Skills include React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Python, AWS, Tailwind CSS, and related full-stack web technologies.
